headline: Shailendra Sinha resigns as MD of Universus Photo Imagings
hook: Managing Director exits Universus Photo Imagings
summary: Universus Photo Imagings Limited has officially announced the resignation of its Managing Director, Shailendra Sinha. The resignation is effective from November 5, 2026. The company has notified the NSE regarding this leadership change. No successor has been named in the filing.
whats_next: Announcement of a new Managing Director or interim leadership.
why_it_matters: Leadership transition may signal upcoming strategic shifts for the company.
